title: Vehicle accessory fuse box
goal: Show a protected 12 V accessory system with switched relay loads and clearly visible chassis returns.

rubric.must: A 12 V battery feeds a labelled 300 A main isolator switch.
Five separately labelled fused ways with different visible current ratings are shown after the main feed.
A clearly labelled 100 A main fuse is visible between the isolator and the fused ways.
Two labelled relays drive the driving lights and air compressor loads.
A dashboard light switch, compressor switch, and two indicator lamps are visible.
The battery and each accessory load visibly return to a chassis earth connection.
Reference designators and electrical ratings are legible beside the corresponding parts.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. Battery, isolator, main fuse and a fused bus with five ways at real automotive ratings; each relay's coil and contact are tied by a dashed association line, the dash switches are grouped, and every load returns to the chassis. One flaw left in place: the 'Battery & main protection' section caption overlaps the isolator's label.
